title: Congestive Heart Failure (CHF) 30-Day Readmission Propensity & Timing

scenarios.scenario_name: HFrEF Acute Decompensated Heart Failure Discharges
scenarios.description: Reduced ejection fraction (~20% readmission rate) with fluid weight and NT-proBNP elevation.
High loop diuretic dose + 7-day weight gain + eGFR drop driving rapid 14-day readmission.
Preserved ejection fraction with atrial/renal comorbidities and medication adherence gaps.
Broad community CHF discharges under telemonitoring and RN home-visit slot caps.
